# Loan Risk Assessment and Monitoring

This document outlines critical tasks related to the ongoing management and assessment of loan risks, as identified from a confidential bank document (Ref ID: CRL-BATCH-048, Date: 2026-04-03).

## Urgent Actions Required:

*   Monitor the borrower credit score urgently.
*   Investigate the collateral value urgently.
*   Update the default risk standard.
*   Update the default risk based on audit findings.
*   Review the interest rates for strategy 2026.
